title: Dental inlay or onlay
what: An inlay is a strong piece made to fit the exact shape of the damaged part of a tooth. It is bonded in place instead of a large filling.
why: When a tooth is badly damaged and a regular filling may not hold.
duration: usually 2 visits of about 1 hour; the inlay is usually made in a few days to 2 weeks
tell_doctor: If this tooth was treated before

prepare.title: Teeth
prepare.text: Brush your teeth before the visit.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Eat beforehand. After the shot, eating is awkward for a few hours.

bring: X-rays of the tooth, if you have them
steps: The tooth is numbed with a shot
The dentist removes the old filling and decay, and shapes the tooth
An impression or scan of the tooth is taken
At the second visit, the inlay is tried in and your bite is checked
The inlay is bonded in and polished
feel: Noise and vibration from the tools
The tooth may ache a little for a couple of days
after: Do not eat until the numbness wears off
With the temporary filling, do not chew hard or sticky food on that side
After the inlay is in, brush and care as usual
red_flags: Severe pain, or swelling of the gum or cheek
The inlay is loose or has fallen out: keep it and book a visit

faq.q: Why is an inlay better than a filling?
faq.a: It is stronger and fits the shape more exactly. It suits badly damaged teeth.
Usually ceramic, composite, or metal. Your dentist will suggest the right one.

faq.q: Does the nerve need to be removed?
faq.a: Not always. It depends on the state of the tooth.

reminders.text: Dentist visit in 2 hours. Brush your teeth and eat beforehand.
